quarterly_data.signal: Nebius' Q2 2026 shareholder letter (6-K), deal economics: TCV of deals closed in Q2 grew nearly 4x quarter-over-quarter, with TCV from new customers growing more than 9x; pricing on older-generation GPUs was more than 30% higher versus Q1. The majority of the Q2 deals were signed against capacity arriving in late 2026 and will contribute primarily to 2027 revenue. Its first short-term capacity deal (Q3) is dedicated capacity expected to go live in Q4.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 TCV nearly 4x QoQ (new customers more than 9x); older-generation GPU pricing more than 30% higher vs Q1

quarterly_data.signal: Nebius' Q2 2026 shareholder letter (6-K), named customer wins beyond the four landmark deals: AMI, co-founded by Yann LeCun, uses Nebius compute and storage for AI research and model training; Basecamp Research trained EDEN, a 28-billion-parameter biological foundation model, on 9.7 trillion tokens entirely on Nebius at 20x faster training speed than its previous internal environments; Prima Mente scaled its Alzheimer's and Parkinson's epigenetic foundation model from 1 billion to 68 billion parameters on a dedicated Nebius cluster; and Higgsfield has expanded its usage of the platform by more than 20x since its first contract.

Nebius' Q2 2026 shareholder letter (6-K): Nebius uses a five-year useful life for its server and network equipment, up from the four-year useful life used prior to 2026; Q2 product development expenses of $191.0 million included $115.9 million of non-recurring share-based compensation and post-combination expenses recognized in connection with the acquisition of Eigen AI.
quarterly_data.figure: server and network equipment useful life five years (four years before 2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Nebius' Q2 2026 shareholder letter (6-K), Avride (autonomous vehicles and delivery robots): the AV-capable fleet nearly tripled since year-end 2025 to more than 200 vehicles in May 2026, with more than one million autonomous miles completed in 2026 and over 60,000 commercial rides completed on Uber in Dallas; robot deliveries more than tripled year-over-year in Q2 and exceeded 600,000 since inception, with robodelivery launched in Arlington, Virginia and Miami through UberEats and, in July, a Master Services Agreement with Chartwells Higher Education.
quarterly_data.figure: more than 200 AV-capable vehicles; over 60,000 commercial Uber rides; over 600,000 robot deliveries

quarterly_data.signal: Nebius' Q2 2026 shareholder letter (6-K): the expected payback period for the associated capex and related operating costs of deals signed in Q2 is 1 year and 10 months, down from Nebius' historical two-to-three-year range (an estimate based on forecast costs and contracted future capacity, including capacity not yet built). Production inference workloads on Token Factory more than tripled in Q2. Nebius expanded its contracted capacity footprint in Q2 with additional sites in the UK, Estonia and Finland, and construction is underway at some of its owned AI factories in the US.
quarterly_data.figure: payback period 1 year and 10 months for Q2 deals (previously two to three years); Token Factory production inference workloads more than tripled in Q2
